🔘 Buttons & Interactive Controls

Standard TDEI button classes with hover, active, and accessible focus states.
.tdei-primary-button Main Call to Action
<Button className="tdei-primary-button">
  Create Project Group
</Button>
.tdei-secondary-button Secondary / Cancel
<Button className="tdei-secondary-button">
  Cancel Operation
</Button>
.tdei-rounded-button Pill Style Primary
<Button className="tdei-rounded-button">
  Upload Dataset
</Button>
.tdei-button2 (Cyan Accent) Refresh / Secondary Action
<Button className="tdei-button2">
  Refresh Status
</Button>
.maroon-bg (Danger Action) Destructive / Delete
<Button className="maroon-bg">
  Deactivate Service
</Button>
.tdei-primary-link & Disabled State Links & Disabled
↗ Manage Organization POCs
<Link className="tdei-primary-link" to="...">
  Manage POCs
</Link>

📋 Forms & Input Controls

Text inputs, custom purple checkboxes, radio buttons, and required field decorators.
Text Input & Required Indicator
* Enter a descriptive unique name for this service
<Form.Label>Service Name <span style={{{{ color: 'red' }}}}>*</span></Form.Label>
<Form.Control className="tdei-input" />
Checkboxes & Radio Options
input[type=checkbox] {{ appearance: none; border: 1.5px solid var(--secondary-color); }}
input[type=checkbox]:checked {{ background: var(--primary-color); }}

💻 Developer Quick Copy Cheat Sheet

One-click copy for the full CSS variables block, React import templates, and design token JSON.

1. Root CSS Variables

:root {
  --primary-font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
  --secondary-font-family: "Montserrat", sans-serif;
  --brand-primary: #32006e;
  --brand-accent: #4b2e83;
  --primary-color: var(--brand-primary);
  --primary-color-dark: var(--brand-primary);
  --secondary-color: #5f647a;
  --tdei-blue: #586AB5;
  --tdei-green: #479FA1;
  --purple-background-light: #f4f0fb;
  --purple-background-dark: #ddd2ee;
  --purple-background-medium: #ebe4f6;
  --white: #ffffff;
}
